V. 31.
The blaſphemy againſt the Spirit—How much Stir has been made about this? How many Sermons, yea, Volumes have been written concerning it? And yet there is nothing plainer in all the Bible. It is neither more nor leſs, than the aſcribing thoſe Miracles to the Power of the Devil, which Chriſt wrought by the Power of the Holy Ghoſt.
